root_cause_label: Agent halted after single reconnaissance step with no output captured, never completing any task requirements
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent stopped after a single filesystem exploration command whose output was not captured by the scaffold, failing to read any CSV files, perform interpolation, or create the required flood_summary.json.
t_err_evidence: Step 1: Agent runs `ls -la /` (broad root listing) instead of directly examining /data CSV files; terminal output shows '(command not found in terminal output)', indicating scaffold failure to capture output, and the agent never recovers or continues.
t_commit_evidence: With only 1 step total and no further actions taken, the outcome was locked in at step 1 — the single step produced no usable output and execution halted entirely.
t_surface_evidence: Step 1 terminal output: '(command not found in terminal output)' — the missing/uncaptured output is the observable failure signal indicating the scaffold could not relay the command result.
trigger_explanation: The scaffold failed to capture the output of `ls -la /`, returning '(command not found in terminal output)'. The agent did not handle this environment obstacle — it never retried, never attempted an alternative command, and the trajectory ended after this single failed step. The environment blocker (no output captured) was mishandled by simply stopping.
